authority.name: Inscriptiones Graecae XV 1 digital edition
authority.institution: Berlin-Brandenburg Academy of Sciences and Humanities

coverage_context.planned_scope_note: The larger Cypriot syllabic corpus extends beyond the first published fascicle; current repo snapshot must not be called whole-corpus exhaustive.

verification_method: Use authoritative IG record metadata/transliteration and stable IG identifiers; keep photographs/drawings subject to their own rights and do not infer independent witnesses from duplicate repo representations.
shared_source_dependency: Cypriot-syllabic-Greek and Eteocypriot may encode the same IG object/components; cross-repo duplication is never independent evidence.
